The '''Republic Futures Program''' was an educational program established by the [[Galactic Republic]] for the purpose of identifying the most promising youth and nurturing their intellect. It had local branches, including a [[Brentaal Futures Program|facility]] on [[Brentaal IV]],<ref name="Catalyst" /> and [[Rocantor Sector Futures Program|another]] in the [[Rocantor sector]].<ref name="Rebel Dossier" /> Astrophysics and energy generation and enhancement, among others, were some of the specialities offered at the program's institute on [[Coruscant]]. Notable alumni of the program included [[Dagio Belcoze]], [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]], [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]], [[Reeva Demesne]],<ref name="Catalyst" /> [[Kelad]],<ref name="TPatS">''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]''</ref> and [[Uyohn]].<ref name="Rogue One Novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref>
